people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.
translations.bsb: But the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the rooms and the treasuries of the house of God.
translations.kjv: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.
